# YNX Chain Press Kit

Version: 1.0.0-candidate  
Last reviewed: 2026-07-22  
Source commit: `719e1018267ed5a53e6fae5211c5fd8a1503c35c`

## Boilerplate

YNX Chain is a Web4 Layer-1 ecosystem. YNX Web4 is the application ecosystem powered by YNX Chain. YNXT is the native asset of YNX Testnet, which uses EVM Chain ID 6423 and Cosmos chain ID `ynx_6423-1`. The current materials describe a Testnet and product candidates; they do not announce Mainnet, monetary value, guaranteed liquidity, production signing, app-store release, regulatory approval, or third-party partnership.

## Short description

YNX Chain documents a Testnet-oriented Layer-1 and application ecosystem with evidence-linked technical, operational, security, economic and risk boundaries.

## Approved facts

- Official site name: YNX Chain.
- Alternate names: YNX, YNX Web4 and YNXWeb4.
- Domain: `https://ynxweb4.com`.
- Testnet: YNX Testnet.
- Native Testnet asset: YNXT.
- EVM chain ID: 6423; Cosmos chain ID: `ynx_6423-1`.
- YNX is not affiliated with unrelated Lynx-branded products.

## Not approved

Do not claim launch, adoption, user count, transaction volume, performance at scale, decentralization, audit completion, partnerships, listings, reserve backing, redemption, liquidity, APY/yield, revenue, burn/buyback, token allocation, price, funding, awards or regulatory status without a new evidence record.

## Assets

The current source logo is a candidate asset with SHA-256 `df071f540f21d54e92286fd709df5293187c269058850820adb11e7c5087c12d`, 104,171 bytes and dimensions 798×420. Public URL, rights approval, light/dark variants and icon exports remain pending. No reviewed product screenshot is included.

## Media handling

Answers must distinguish implemented locally, tested locally, integrated, deployed, publicly available, downloadable, production signed and store released. Quote current public evidence rather than plans. Route legal, financial, security-incident and partnership questions to approved owners once contact URLs exist; none is asserted by this candidate.
